# Flora Jane & Spencer

- [Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md) — Child of — [Spencer](../character/spencer.md) — since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visit Mrs. [Spencer](../character/spencer.md) to address the mix-up regarding Anne's adoption. When the harsh Mrs. [Blewett](../character/peter-blewett.md) offers to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as a servant, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) hesitates and decides to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back home first. Later at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) to keep [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and adopt her.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind
